name: MusicBrainz
tagline: Open music encyclopedia API for artists, releases, recordings, and relationships
description: MusicBrainz provides a free, community-maintained music metadata API covering artists, releases, recordings, labels, works, and relationships. The JSON/XML web service is the primary developer interface, with strict rate limits and a required identifying User-Agent.

auth.details: No API key. Identify with a descriptive User-Agent (app name + contact URL or email). OAuth is optional for edit/submit operations.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a license agreement with MetaBrainz
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial licensing available via MetaBrainz Foundation

rate_limits: 1 request per second average; bursts may be throttled; anonymous/shared IPs more restricted
use_cases: look up an artist by MusicBrainz ID
search releases by title and artist
resolve ISRC or barcode to a recording/release
get relationships (members, covers, samples) for an entity
fetch track listings and medium info for a release
